release_notes: The handbook, checked against the application. A reader reported that the training sessions told them to run a Python script, which is not something a bookkeeper opening the app can do. Checking that sentence turned into a chapter-by-chapter review of all 23 chapters against the 2.6.3 screens. It found instructions that could not be followed, claims the program did not support, and GST box numbers that did not match the return the app names. The GST figures now carry the boxes on the form that is filed. GST on sales is box 8, GST on purchases is box 12, and the amount to pay or refund is box 15 — the numbers on the GST101A return, which is what the app's working papers say they are. …
